items.name: fsync and flushing to disk
items.explanation: Writes first land in the operating system's memory. fsync asks the system to flush a file's changes to the storage device and waits until the device says it is done, so a crash cannot lose them.

assumedBy.quote: fsyncs these files, and updates the index

items.name: ZooKeeper as a coordination service
items.explanation: ZooKeeper is a replicated coordination service that distributed programs use to build things like group membership, ownership and synchronisation, instead of writing that logic themselves.

assumedBy.quote: We also use Zookeeper for leader election

sources.title: ZooKeeper: A Distributed Coordination Service for Distributed Applications
